Power training designed around 3-4 sessions per week for elite climbers

This 6-week program is designed for advanced climbers climbing at least V11 (8A) or higher or 5.14 (8b+) and above with an extensive power training history.  It is recommend climbers following this program spread the training over 3-4 days per week.
